_note: Gloria Steinem's own words only, each checked against the page in 'url' on 2026-10-23.

quotes.text: The truth will set you free, but first it will piss you off!
quotes.source: Title of her 2019 book; she used the line in speeches by 1998-99
quotes.note: Saying predates Steinem (in circulation by 1990, per Quote Investigator); she popularized it and used it as her 2019 book title.

quotes.text: I'm gonna make a button some day that says, 'The truth will set you free, but it's gonna piss you off first.'
quotes.source: Speech reported in The Pantagraph, Feb 1999
quotes.note: Wording is the newspaper's report of her speech; saying not originated by Steinem.

quotes.text: A woman without a man is like a fish without a bicycle.
quotes.note: Widely misattributed to Steinem. She credited Irina Dunn (Australian activist, graffito c.1970); a 1977 Iowa newspaper credited Florynce Kennedy; earlier variants exist.

quotes.text: This is no simple reform.
quotes.source: Address to the Women of America, 10 Jul 1971

quotes.text: It really is a revolution.
quotes.source: Address to the Women of America, 10 Jul 1971

quotes.text: We are talking about a society in which there will be no roles other than those chosen or those earned.
quotes.source: Address to the Women of America, 10 Jul 1971

quotes.text: We have people power and we will use it.
quotes.source: Women's March on Washington speech, 21 Jan 2017

quotes.text: We've elected an impossible president, we're never going home.
quotes.source: Women's March on Washington speech, 21 Jan 2017

quotes.text: God may be in the details, but the goddess is in connections.
quotes.source: Women's March on Washington speech, 21 Jan 2017

quotes.text: If you force Muslims to register, we will all register as Muslims.
quotes.source: Women's March on Washington speech, 21 Jan 2017

quotes.text: Remember, the Constitution doesn't begin with, 'I, the president.' It begins with, 'We, the people.'
quotes.source: Women's March on Washington speech, 21 Jan 2017

quotes.text: Change is like a house—you can’t build it from the top down, only from the bottom up.
Progress is not automatic—that's what movements are for.
The voting booth is still the only place that a pauper equals a billionaire, and any woman equals any man.
But this is a revolution, not a public relations movement.
I’m skeptical, but optimistic. I’m not pessimistic because I think pessimism defeats you before you start.
We’re on the cusp of something big, something that says we’re a circle, and not hierarchical.
A feminist is anyone who recognizes the equality and full humanity of women and men.
We are the women our parents warned us against, and we are proud.
Women may be the one group that grows more radical with age.
Men should think twice before making widowhood woman's only path to power.
Many of us have raised our daughters more like our sons, but too few have raised our sons more like our daughters.
If feminism means anything, it means taking responsibility for ourselves: for our own lives and actions.
A liberated woman is one who has sex before marriage and a job after.
Revolutions that last don't happen from the top down. They happen from the bottom up.
Women have always taken power over our own bodies, and we will keep right on.
Women are becoming the men we wanted to marry. (But too few men are becoming the women they wanted to marry)
quotes.source: Quoted in The Truth Will Set You Free, But First It Will Piss You Off (2019)

quotes.text: For women, the only alternative to being a feminist is being a masochist.
quotes.source: Quoted in The Truth Will Set You Free, But First It Will Piss You Off (2019)

quotes.text: So many of us are living out the unlived lives of our mothers.
quotes.source: Quoted in The Truth Will Set You Free, But First It Will Piss You Off (2019)

quotes.text: Whatever you want to do, just do it. Making a damn fool of yourself is absolutely essential.
quotes.source: Quoted in The Truth Will Set You Free, But First It Will Piss You Off (2019)

quotes.text: Marriage has worked better for men than for women. The two happiest groups are married men and unmarried women.
quotes.source: Quoted in The Truth Will Set You Free, But First It Will Piss You Off (2019)

quotes.text: Your daughters are watching you.
quotes.source: Quoted in The Truth Will Set You Free, But First It Will Piss You Off (2019)

quotes.text: The best thing about self-defense is knowing there is a self worth defending.
quotes.source: Quoted in The Truth Will Set You Free, But First It Will Piss You Off (2019)

quotes.text: Beware of any motto that glorifies the past. It's code for restoring hierarchy. For example: "Make America great again."
quotes.source: Quoted in The Truth Will Set You Free, But First It Will Piss You Off (2019)

quotes.text: Women have to learn how to talk as much as we listen. Men have to learn how to listen as much as they talk.
quotes.source: Quoted in The Truth Will Set You Free, But First It Will Piss You Off (2019)

quotes.text: There is no virtue in being on the same page if it's the wrong page.
quotes.source: Quoted in The Truth Will Set You Free, But First It Will Piss You Off (2019)

quotes.text: None of us can be liberated if other groups are not.
The future depends entirely on what each of us does every day; a movement is only people moving.
Once we give up searching for approval we often find it easier to earn respect.
Empathy is the most radical of human emotions.
Feminism isn't called the longest revolution for nothing.
Don’t think about making women fit the world — think about making the world fit women.
Power can be taken, but not given. The process of the taking is empowerment in itself.
We are linked, not ranked.
quotes.source: Steinem catchphrase (source not specified by page)
